proof_body:
by
  intro p hp
  have h : -p < -1 := by linarith
  refine ⟨integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt h one_pos, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt h one_pos, Real.one_rpow]
  have h1 : p - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h2 : -p + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  field_simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ p : ℝ, 1 < p → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-p)) (Set.Ioi 1) ∧ (∫ x in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), x ^ (-p)) = 1 / (p - 1)
